title: Kyle Shanahan: Nothing's changed for me with Brandon Aiyuk, I've moved on mentally

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan: Nothing's changed for me with Brandon Aiyuk, I've moved on mentally
sources.description: When 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan was asked in September if the team's injury issues at wide receiver had led him to consider bringing Brandon Aiyuk back, his answer was a strong no.
